facets.F1_correctness: The substrate DAG acyclicity gate now reads the DAG path from a gate-local policy JSON instead of a Rust DAG_PATH constant, while preserving the same live DAG verdict and explicit --dag override behavior.
facets.F2_tests: Buck2 build, Buck2 check, Buck2 unit tests, Buck2 live gate tests, clippy diagnostics subtarget, rustfmt check, and Buck2 binary smoke runs passed for the changed cloud-ci gate.
facets.F3_maintainability: Repo-specific adoption data is isolated in substrate-dependency-dag-policy.json; the Rust crate remains a neutral graph/policy parser with focused parser tests.
facets.F4_compatibility: The binary keeps --dag as an explicit override and adds --policy for alternate data packs. The default Oyatie policy points at the same specs/substrate-dependency-dag.json as before.
facets.F5_security: Policy dag_path parsing fails closed on wrong gate_id, absolute paths, empty paths, and parent-directory escapes; no unsafe code, network, credentials, or production side effects are introduced.
facets.F6_privacy: No user, tenant, customer, or regulated data is read or added; only CI policy metadata and existing substrate DAG structure are involved.
facets.F7_operability: The Buck2 gate and binary keep the same GREEN report shape while making the DAG path configurable by data pack for future non-Oyatie adoption.
facets.F8_performance: The change adds one small policy JSON read at binary/live-test startup; graph evaluation complexity and Buck2 target shape remain unchanged.
facets.F9_compliance: No generated JSON was touched; Cargo command execution was blocked by repo policy and verification used Buck2 as canonical authority.
facets.F10_reversibility: Rollback is a normal git revert of one cloud-ci gate directory plus this append-only evidence file; no migrations or external state changes are involved.
facets.F11_observability: Gate output remains deterministic and now reports policy-loading errors distinctly from DAG parse errors, improving operator diagnosis.
facets.F13_migration: Moves cloud-ci one step from repo-specific bridge behavior toward universal Rust API/data-pack boundaries by putting the DAG adoption point in policy data.
facets.M1_challenge_assumption: Rejected the earlier idea to add Cargo.toml to the Buck-only rust-first automation hygiene gate after root Cargo comments showed that absence is intentional.
facets.M2_zoomed_out_fit: This is a narrow M2 Lane 3 cloud-ci slice: one gate-local data-pack boundary, no workflow/status-context changes, no lane-4 generated-artifact surface, and no generated outputs.

hyperscaler_lens.improved_criterion: cloud-ci universal product/API boundary and data-pack portability
hyperscaler_lens.provider_neutrality: The graph engine contains no cloud provider SDK, shell bridge, VCS dependency, or Oyatie DAG path constant; adopters can point policy data at their DAG document.
hyperscaler_lens.merge_conflict_resistance: All source changes are contained to one cloud-ci gate directory plus one unique append-only evidence JSON; no generated faces, workflows, oya-ci.toml, or root policy files changed.
